title: Include subclass instances in get_all searches
body:
## The change

`get_all(Base)` uses only objects that directly reference `Base`, so it misses instances of subclasses even with `include_subtypes=True` (the default). Search GC-tracked objects when subtypes are requested. Retain the direct-reference optimization for exact-type searches and document the performance distinction.

Validation: the base/child/grandchild regression fails on master and passes after the fix; full suite passes with 679 tests and 12 subtests.

## The backstory

Earlier contribution from this account: #555. Found while checking that the documented subtype option returns instances across an ordinary three-level class hierarchy. No separate issue was filed.

## AI assistance

- Harness/tooling: Codex
- Model(s): GPT-6
- Original prompt(s): “再改30个10分钟之内可以验证，改正然后提交的issue，提交pr哈。可以多叫几个subagent帮你搞” (Find and fix another 30 issues that can be verified within 10 minutes, and submit PRs; subagents may help.)
